data.name: ServiceAvailable
data.value: Windows MIDI Services is available.

data.name: ServiceUnavailable
data.value: Windows MIDI Services is not available on this PC.

data.name: TransportUnavailableFormat
data.value: The {0} transport is not available on this PC.
data.comment: {0} is the name of a transport, such as Network MIDI 2.0.

data.name: TransportNameBasicLoopback
data.value: MIDI 1.0 basic loopback

data.name: TransportNameLoopback
data.value: MIDI 2.0 loopback

data.name: TransportNameNetwork
data.value: Network MIDI 2.0
data.comment: Name of a MIDI Association standard. Usually left in English.

data.name: TransportNameRtp
data.value: RTP-MIDI
data.comment: Name of a network protocol. Usually left in English.

data.name: TransportNameSynth
data.value: General MIDI synthesizer

data.name: ConfigurationBackupWrittenFormat
data.value: A backup of the previous configuration was written to {0}.
data.comment: {0} is the full path of the backup file.

data.name: ConfigurationNotSaved
data.value: The change was applied, but could not be saved, so it will be lost when the service restarts.

data.name: ConfigurationNotSavedReasonFormat
data.value: {0} The change was applied, but will be lost when the service restarts.
data.comment: {0} is the reason the service gave, as a full sentence.

data.name: ConfigurationSavedFormat
data.value: Saved to the configuration file {0}.
data.comment: {0} is the full path of the configuration file.

data.name: SessionAlreadyStopped
data.value: The MIDI session was already stopped.

data.name: SessionCreationFailed
data.value: A MIDI session could not be created.

data.name: SessionNamedCreationFailedFormat
data.value: Unable to create the MIDI session "{0}".
data.comment: {0} is the session name the caller chose.

data.name: SessionRequired
data.value: An open MIDI session is required.

data.name: SessionRequiredStartFirst
data.value: An open MIDI session is required. Use Start-MidiSession first.
data.comment: Start-MidiSession is a command name. Do not translate it.

data.name: SessionStarted
data.value: MIDI session started.

data.name: SessionStopAction
data.value: Stop MIDI session

data.name: SessionStopped
data.value: MIDI session stopped.

data.name: SessionTemporaryNameFormat
data.value: PowerShell {0}
data.comment: Name of a session a single command opens for itself. Other tools show it in their list of apps using an endpoint. {0} is the command name, such as Send-MidiSystemExclusive.

data.name: ConnectionCloseAction
data.value: Close MIDI endpoint connection

data.name: ConnectionClosedFormat
data.value: MIDI endpoint connection {0} closed.
data.comment: {0} is the connection id, a GUID.

data.name: ConnectionCreationFailedFormat
data.value: Unable to create a connection to "{0}".
data.comment: {0} is an endpoint device id.

data.name: ConnectionNotOpen
data.value: The MIDI endpoint connection is not open.

data.name: ConnectionOpenFailedFormat
data.value: Unable to open the connection to "{0}".
data.comment: {0} is an endpoint device id.

data.name: ConnectionRequired
data.value: An open MIDI endpoint connection is required. Use Open-MidiEndpointConnection first.
data.comment: Open-MidiEndpointConnection is a command name. Do not translate it.

data.name: EndpointDeviceIdInvalidFormat
data.value: '{0}' is not a Windows MIDI Services endpoint device id.
data.comment: {0} is the text the caller passed in.

data.name: EndpointDeviceIdNotExpandableFormat
data.value: '{0}' could not be expanded into an endpoint device id.
data.comment: {0} is the text the caller passed in.

data.name: EndpointNotFoundFormat
data.value: No MIDI endpoint was found with the identifier "{0}".
data.comment: {0} is an endpoint device id.

data.name: LegacyPortNotFoundFormat
data.value: No MIDI 1.0 port was found with the identifier "{0}".
data.comment: {0} is a port device id.

data.name: MessageNotSentFormat
data.value: The MIDI message was not sent. Send result: {0}.
data.comment: {0} is the result code, an English name such as EndpointConnectionClosedOrInvalid.

data.name: MessageSentFormat
data.value: MIDI message with {0} UMP words sent with timestamp {1}.
data.comment: {0} is a number from 1 to 4. {1} is a timestamp, a large number.

data.name: FileExistsFormat
data.value: The file "{0}" already exists. Use -Force to overwrite it.
data.comment: {0} is a full file path. -Force is a parameter name. Do not translate it.

data.name: CaptureDefaultTrackName
data.value: MIDI capture
data.comment: Track name written into the captured file when the endpoint has no name.

data.name: CaptureGroupTrackNameFormat
data.value: {0} - group {1}
data.comment: Track name written into the captured file. {0} is the endpoint name. {1} is the group number, 1 to 16.

data.name: CaptureLimitReachedFormat
data.value: The capture stopped when it reached its limit of {0:N0} messages.
data.comment: {0:N0} is the message limit.

data.name: CaptureNothingReceived
data.value: No MIDI messages were received, so no file was written.

data.name: CaptureNothingStorable
data.value: None of the messages received can be stored in a Standard MIDI File, so no file was written.

data.name: CaptureProgressActivityFormat
data.value: Capturing MIDI messages from {0}
data.comment: Progress bar title. {0} is the endpoint name.

data.name: CaptureProgressStatusFormat
data.value: {0:N0} messages. Press Ctrl+C to stop and save the file.
data.comment: Progress bar status. {0:N0} is the number of messages captured so far.

data.name: CaptureProgressWaiting
data.value: Waiting for messages
data.comment: Progress bar status before the first update.

data.name: CaptureSkippedFormat
data.value: {0:N0} messages have no MIDI 1.0 equivalent, so a Standard MIDI File cannot hold them. They were left out.
data.comment: {0:N0} is the number of messages left out.

data.name: CaptureWriteFailedFormat
data.value: The Standard MIDI File could not be written: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason, an English status name.

data.name: CaptureWrittenFormat
data.value: Captured {0:N0} messages and wrote {1} tracks, {2:N0} bytes.
data.comment: {0:N0} is the number of messages. {1} is the number of tracks. {2:N0} is the file size in bytes.

data.name: SysExByteCountFormat
data.value: {0} bytes
data.comment: Describes the data being sent, inside SysExSendActionFormat. {0} is a number of bytes.

data.name: SysExFileNotFoundFormat
data.value: The file "{0}" was not found.
data.comment: {0} is a full file path.

data.name: SysExListeningFormat
data.value: Listening on group {0} of {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the group number, 1 to 16. {1} is an endpoint device id.

data.name: SysExReceivedFormat
data.value: Received {0:N0} bytes in {1:N0} messages.
data.comment: {0:N0} is the number of bytes. {1:N0} is the number of messages.

data.name: SysExReceiveStartFailed
data.value: Unable to start receiving system exclusive data.

data.name: SysExSendActionFormat
data.value: Send system exclusive data ({0})
data.comment: {0} is a full file path, or the text from SysExByteCountFormat.

data.name: SysExSendIncomplete
data.value: The system exclusive transfer did not complete.

data.name: SysExSendProgressActivity
data.value: Sending system exclusive data
data.comment: Progress bar title.

data.name: SysExSendProgressPreparing
data.value: Preparing
data.comment: Progress bar status before the first update.

data.name: SysExSendProgressStatusFormat
data.value: Read {0:N0} of {1:N0} bytes, sent {2:N0} messages
data.comment: Progress bar status. {0:N0} is bytes read so far. {1:N0} is the total. {2:N0} is the number of messages sent.

data.name: SysExSentFormat
data.value: Read {0:N0} bytes and sent {1:N0} UMP messages.
data.comment: {0:N0} is the number of bytes. {1:N0} is the number of messages.

data.name: PlaybackAlreadyStopped
data.value: Playback had already stopped.

data.name: PlaybackEndpointFailedFormat
data.value: The endpoint could not be opened for playback: {0}
data.comment: {0} is an endpoint device id.

data.name: PlaybackFileNotFound
data.value: The MIDI file was not found.

data.name: PlaybackFileTruncated
data.value: The file ended sooner than it said it would. Playing what was read.

data.name: PlaybackFileUnreadable
data.value: The MIDI file could not be read.

data.name: PlaybackFileUnreadableFormat
data.value: The MIDI file could not be read: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason, an English status name.

data.name: PlaybackNoEndpoint
data.value: No endpoint was given and the built-in synthesizer is not available. Pass -EndpointDeviceId.
data.comment: -EndpointDeviceId is a parameter name. Do not translate it.

data.name: PlaybackNotPausedFormat
data.value: Only a file which is paused can be resumed. This one is {0}.
data.comment: {0} is the playback state, an English name such as Stopped.

data.name: PlaybackNotPlayingFormat
data.value: Only a file which is playing can be paused. This one is {0}.
data.comment: {0} is the playback state, an English name such as Stopped.

data.name: PlaybackPauseAction
data.value: Pause MIDI file playback

data.name: PlaybackPaused
data.value: MIDI file playback paused.

data.name: PlaybackProgressActivity
data.value: Playing MIDI file
data.comment: Progress bar title.

data.name: PlaybackProgressStatusFormat
data.value: Bar {0}, beat {1}, {2:F0} BPM
data.comment: Progress bar status. {0} is the bar number. {1} is the beat number. {2:F0} is the tempo in beats per minute.

data.name: PlaybackResumeAction
data.value: Resume MIDI file playback

data.name: PlaybackResumed
data.value: MIDI file playback resumed.

data.name: PlaybackSessionNameFormat
data.value: PowerShell playback of {0}
data.comment: Name of the session that plays the file. Other tools show it in their list of apps using an endpoint. {0} is the file name.

data.name: PlaybackStartBeyondEndFormat
data.value: The file is only {0:F1} seconds long.
data.comment: {0:F1} is the length of the file in seconds.

data.name: PlaybackStartedFormat
data.value: Playing {0} to {1} on group {2}.
data.comment: {0} is a full file path. {1} is an endpoint device id. {2} is the group number, 1 to 16.

data.name: PlaybackStopAction
data.value: Stop MIDI file playback

data.name: PlaybackStopped
data.value: MIDI file playback stopped.

data.name: PlaybackStoppedEarly
data.value: Stopped before the end of the file.

data.name: PlaybackSynthDisabled
data.value: The built-in synthesizer is switched off, so it has no endpoint. Turn it on with Set-MidiSynth -Enabled, or pass -EndpointDeviceId.
data.comment: Set-MidiSynth is a command name, and -Enabled and -EndpointDeviceId are parameter names. Do not translate them.

data.name: CiAskingResponderFormat
data.value: Asking responder {0} on function block {1}.
data.comment: {0} identifies the device, as in MIDI Unique Id 262163041. It is always in English. {1} is the function block number.

data.name: CiChannelListNotSentFormat
data.value: MIDI-CI responder {0} did not send a channel list.
data.comment: {0} identifies the device, as in MIDI Unique Id 262163041. It is always in English.

data.name: CiLookingForDevicesFormat
data.value: Looking for MIDI-CI devices on group {0} of {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the group number, 1 to 16. {1} is an endpoint device id.

data.name: CiNamedProgramListNotSentFormat
data.value: MIDI-CI responder {0} did not send program list "{1}".
data.comment: {0} identifies the device, as in MIDI Unique Id 262163041. It is always in English. {1} is the name the device uses for one of its program lists.

data.name: CiNoPropertyExchange
data.value: The device answered MIDI-CI Discovery, but does not offer Property Exchange, which is how it would publish this list.
data.comment: Discovery and Property Exchange are names of parts of the MIDI-CI standard.

data.name: CiNoResponderFormat
data.value: Nothing answered MIDI-CI Discovery on group {0}, so this endpoint does not support MIDI Capability Inquiry there.
data.comment: {0} is the group number, 1 to 16. Discovery is the name of a part of the MIDI-CI standard.

data.name: CiProgramListNotOfferedFormat
data.value: MIDI-CI responder {0} does not publish a program list.
data.comment: {0} identifies the device, as in MIDI Unique Id 262163041. It is always in English.

data.name: CiProgramListNotSentFormat
data.value: MIDI-CI responder {0} did not send its program list.
data.comment: {0} identifies the device, as in MIDI Unique Id 262163041. It is always in English.

data.name: CiProgramsReceivedFormat
data.value: Received {0} programs.
data.comment: {0} is the number of programs.

data.name: CiSessionFailed
data.value: A MIDI Capability Inquiry session could not be started on the connection.

data.name: LoopbackBasicCreateAction
data.value: Create MIDI 1.0 basic loopback endpoint

data.name: LoopbackBasicCreationFailed
data.value: Unable to create the basic loopback.

data.name: LoopbackBasicExistsFormat
data.value: A basic loopback with the unique identifier "{0}" already exists.
data.comment: {0} is the unique identifier, letters and digits only.

data.name: LoopbackBasicMuteAction
data.value: Mute MIDI 1.0 basic loopback

data.name: LoopbackBasicRemovalFailed
data.value: Unable to remove the basic loopback.

data.name: LoopbackBasicRemoveAction
data.value: Remove MIDI 1.0 basic loopback endpoint

data.name: LoopbackBasicUnmuteAction
data.value: Unmute MIDI 1.0 basic loopback

data.name: LoopbackCreateAction
data.value: Create MIDI 2.0 loopback endpoint pair

data.name: LoopbackCreationFailed
data.value: Unable to create the loopback.

data.name: LoopbackExistsFormat
data.value: A loopback with the unique identifier "{0}" already exists.
data.comment: {0} is the unique identifier, letters and digits only.

data.name: LoopbackInvalidUniqueId
data.value: The unique identifier must contain at least one letter or digit.

data.name: LoopbackMuteAction
data.value: Mute MIDI 2.0 loopback

data.name: LoopbackMuteFailed
data.value: Unable to change the mute state.

data.name: LoopbackNamesMustDifferFormat
data.value: The two endpoint names must differ within the first {0} characters.
data.comment: {0} is the longest name a MIDI 1.0 port can have, 31.

data.name: LoopbackRemovalFailed
data.value: Unable to remove the loopback.

data.name: LoopbackRemoveAction
data.value: Remove MIDI 2.0 loopback endpoint pair

data.name: LoopbackRemoved
data.value: The loopback was removed from the running service. An entry saved in the configuration file is not affected.

data.name: LoopbackSideANameFormat
data.comment: Name of the first endpoint of a new loopback pair. Apps show it as a port name. {0} is the name the caller chose. Keep it short: a MIDI 1.0 port name holds at most 31 characters, and the chosen name is shortened to make room for the rest. Must differ from LoopbackSideBNameFormat.

data.name: LoopbackSideBNameFormat
data.comment: Name of the second endpoint of a new loopback pair. Apps show it as a port name. {0} is the name the caller chose. Keep it short: a MIDI 1.0 port name holds at most 31 characters, and the chosen name is shortened to make room for the rest. Must differ from LoopbackSideANameFormat.

data.name: LoopbackTransient
data.value: This loopback is transient and will disappear when the service restarts. Use -SaveToConfiguration to keep it.
data.comment: -SaveToConfiguration is a parameter name. Do not translate it.

data.name: LoopbackUnmuteAction
data.value: Unmute MIDI 2.0 loopback

data.name: ConnectionTransient
data.value: This connection is transient and will be lost when the service restarts. Use -SaveToConfiguration to keep it.
data.comment: -SaveToConfiguration is a parameter name. Do not translate it.

data.name: HostConnectFailed
data.value: Unable to connect to the host.

data.name: HostDisconnectFailed
data.value: Unable to disconnect the host.

data.name: NetworkClientNotFoundFormat
data.value: No configured network MIDI client matches {0}.
data.comment: {0} is what the caller asked for: a client id, a service instance name, or an address and port.

data.name: NetworkConnectAction
data.value: Connect to network MIDI host

data.name: NetworkDisconnectAction
data.value: Disconnect network MIDI host

data.name: RtpClientNotFoundFormat
data.value: No configured RTP-MIDI client matches {0}.
data.comment: {0} is what the caller asked for: a client id, a service instance name, or an address and port.

data.name: RtpConnectAction
data.value: Connect to RTP-MIDI host

data.name: RtpDisconnectAction
data.value: Disconnect RTP-MIDI host

data.name: RtpReconnectRefusedFormat
data.value: The entry was updated, but will not be tried again until its next retry: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason the service gave.

data.name: RtpReconnectUnanswered
data.value: The entry was updated, but the service did not say whether it will try again now.

data.name: SynthChannelTargetFormat
data.value: Synthesizer channel {0}
data.comment: What -WhatIf and -Confirm show as the target. {0} is the channel number, 1 to 16.

data.name: SynthConflictingState
data.value: Specify either -Enabled or -Disabled, not both.
data.comment: -Enabled and -Disabled are parameter names. Do not translate them.

data.name: SynthDrumChannelAction
data.value: Make it a drum channel

data.name: SynthDrumChannelFailed
data.value: The synthesizer did not accept the change. If nothing is connected to it, open a connection to it with Open-MidiEndpointConnection and try again.
data.comment: Open-MidiEndpointConnection is a command name. Do not translate it.

data.name: SynthInstrumentsUnavailable
data.value: The synthesizer did not report its instruments.

data.name: SynthMelodicChannelAction
data.value: Make it a melodic channel

data.name: SynthNoEndpoint
data.value: The synthesizer has no endpoint. It is most likely switched off.

data.name: SynthNothingToChange
data.value: The synthesizer did not report its status, so there is nothing to change.

data.name: SynthSettingsNotApplied
data.value: The synthesizer settings were not applied.

data.name: SynthSettingsNotAppliedFormat
data.value: The synthesizer settings were not applied: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason, an English status name.

data.name: SynthSoundSetUnavailable
data.value: The synthesizer did not report its sound set.

data.name: SynthStatusUnavailable
data.value: The synthesizer did not report its status.

data.name: SynthTarget
data.value: General MIDI synthesizer
data.comment: What -WhatIf and -Confirm show as the target.

data.name: SynthUpdateAction
data.value: Update the settings

data.name: SynthUpdateAndSaveAction
data.value: Update and save the settings
